Limitation: finite tests do not prove infinite quantifiers; the written argument does.

value.rationale: The concept class is the canonical even-sign subfamily of interleavings of two internally ordered lists, a natural merge-comparison object. The all-support criterion and exact odd-balanced VC drop reveal a sharp failure of transferring the unrestricted two-chain invariant to a parity-restricted class. This is a structural obstruction relevant to parity-aware ranking/learning, not a slice chosen solely because a finite computation was feasible. The claim is independent of unproved adaptive assertions or an unknown all-size coefficient formula.
